task: Write a RED test for a requirement that pins behavior, not implementation (behavior-tests REQ-001, REQ-002)
expect: The skill tells RED to drive the public entry point and assert the observable result, and its Verification Gate rejects vacuous tests and tests that assert only internal calls

assertions.pattern: public entry point its user or caller uses
assert the result that user would see
would still pass if the implementation returned nothing or an empty value (vacuous)
asserts only internal calls or private state
